act.active_desc: Inactive actions are hidden everywhere and cannot be run.
act.attach_to_hint: Leave empty to offer the document as a download instead.
act.available_when_hint: Leave empty to offer the action for every record. Checked again on the server when the action runs.
act.body_hint: Placeholders such as {example} are replaced with the record's values.
act.conditional: Runs only when its condition holds
act.confirm_desc: The user confirms before the action runs.
act.continue_desc: When off, a failing step stops the remaining steps for that record.
act.default_setting: Leave empty to use the system setting.
act.empty_text: Add built-in actions such as bulk update or duplicate, or custom actions that chain steps.
act.headers_hint: Header values are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
act.hint: Buttons users can run on records: in the table, on selected records, or on the record page. Each action has its own permission in the access matrix.
act.justification_hint: Combined with the form's justification rules; the strictest applies.
act.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Used in the permission name.
act.label: Button label
act.link_field_hint: The field in the new record that points back to this record.
act.mode_hint.auto: Runs right away for a few records and in the background above the threshold.
act.mode_hint.queued: Every run is queued and followed with a progress bar.
act.mode_hint.sync: The user waits until every record is done.
act.notify_template_hint: Leave empty to send the action's label and the record title.
act.open_desc: After the run, take the user to the record that was created.
act.permission_hint: Who may run it is set in the access matrix, under this action.
act.run.background: This many records run in the background. You can follow the progress here or leave the page.
act.run.download_failed: The file could not be downloaded.
act.run.failed: The action could not be run.
act.run.leave_open: You can close this window; the run continues and you will be notified.
act.run.no_transitions: No transition is available to you.
act.run.value_hint: Leave empty to clear the field.
act.secret_hint: Each request is signed with HMAC-SHA256 so the receiver can verify it. Stored encrypted.
act.steps_hint: Steps run in order for each record. Each step sees the changes of the steps before it.
act.url_hint: Only hosts allowed in the egress settings can be called. Placeholders are allowed.
act.value_hint: Values are expressions; they can use the record's fields.
